name: Mandelin reagent — cocaine and amphetamine screen
reagent: Mandelin reagent: ammonium vanadate in concentrated sulfuric acid (NIJ Standard-0604.01 appendix A.4)
validationLine: Mandelin cocaine and amphetamine screen — colours from NIJ Standard-0604.01, not yet checked against a real reaction with this app

source.document: NIJ Standard-0604.01, Color Test Reagents/Kits for Preliminary Identification of Drugs of Abuse (US Department of Justice, National Institute of Justice, July 2000)
source.table: Table 1, reagent A.4 (Mandelin), rows marked * (usual kit reagent)
rows: A.4 Cocaine HCl* CHCl3 69 Deep orange yellow 10YR 7/14
A.4 d-Amphetamine HCl* CHCl3 164 Moderate bluish green 5BG 5/6
A.4 d-Methamphetamine HCl* CHCl3 137 Dark yellowish green 10GY 4/6

colourConversion.munsellData: docs/references/munsell/real.dat (RIT Munsell Color Science Laboratory, renotation real.dat, illuminant C, CIE 1931 2°; exact rows, no interpolation)
colourConversion.yScale: Y x 0.975 / 100 (real.dat Y is relative to smoked MgO; 0.975 converts to the perfect diffuser, per the RIT page)
colourConversion.adaptation: Bradford, illuminant C (ASTM E308-01 via docs/references/bradford-lindbloom-excerpt.txt) to the D65 white of src/pipeline/colour.ts
colourConversion.crossCheck: colour-science 0.4.7: largest ΔE00 difference 0.006 over 26 notations

noColourNote: No saved source says that Mandelin reagent is colourless before it reacts, so with this kit the app does not read “no colour” as NEGATIVE: put the test in the white square and take the photo again. A test whose colour is none of the kit’s colours reads INCONCLUSIVE.
noMatchReason: Colour matches no cocaine or amphetamine reaction in the NIJ table

readingTime.source: NIJ Standard-0604.01 §3.3: the final color, generally formed within 1 min or 2 min, after intermediate colours have disappeared

status: Thin evidence: target colours are published Munsell notations (NIJ, 2000) converted to CIELAB, not measurements of real reactions photographed with this app; the correction-error term comes from 3 real photos (the card with an orange-red plastic cap in the zone, Nothing Phone (3a)). POSITIVE has been tested only on synthetic images. Known non-target reactions inside a POSITIVE radius (presumptive-test false positives): Brompheniramine Maleate, Methaqualone. This kit never gives NEGATIVE: no saved source says the reagent is colourless, so “no colour” is a RETAKE.
